name: Brand, Poster & Campaign Image Prompts
body: # Brand, posters, and campaigns Ten Qwen Image 3.0 prompt recipes. Replace bracketed inputs before generation. All quoted text is exact; no translation is implied unless explicitly requested. Outputs require human review. ## MKT-01 — Repairable lamp launch ```text Create a 3:4 launch poster for fictional studio LATCH and its repairable desk lamp. Show one folded ochre lamp on a blue workbench, with its removable shade beside it; the lamp occupies the lower two thirds. Use crisp product photography, soft side light and a restrained editorial grid. Render only "LATCH", "Made to stay", and "Replace a part. Keep the lamp." in descending hierarchy. Keep joints mechanically plausible and parts matched. Add no prices, sustainability certifications or performance claims. Variables: studio name, finish and approved slogan. ``` ## MKT-02 — River reading festival ```text Create a 3:4 illustrated poster for a fictional floating-library festival. A moored blue book barge sits at the lower right; a curved red footbridge guides the eye from the upper-left title to three readers under striped awnings. Use flat screen-print shapes, ivory paper and generous margins. Render exactly "河畔读书节", "RIVER READING DAYS", "川辺の読書会", and "SAT–SUN · 10:00–17:00", each once in a separate block. Preserve Chinese, English and Japanese as supplied. No other signs, sponsors or watermarks. Variables: approved festival copy and palette. ``` ## MKT-03 — Sound archive podcast ```text Create a square cover for a fictional podcast titled "Small Sounds". Show an enlarged brass key resting in a shallow tray, with three delicate concentric vibration rings drawn behind it. Use warm macro photography and a deep aubergine background; place the title across the upper quarter and "Stories worth hearing" below. Both lines must remain readable when viewed at 100 pixels wide. No microphones, headphones, platform badges or episode numbers. Keep one key, realistic reflections and clean negative space. Variables: title, object and background color. ``` ## MKT-04 — Tool comparison thumbnail ```text Create a 16:9 video thumbnail explaining hand-tool selection. Arrange three unbranded screwdrivers vertically on the right, with clearly different slot, cross and hex tips. On the left render only "Which tip fits?" over two lines. Add one small diagram of a matching screw head beneath each tip, without extra labels. Use bright tabletop photography, charcoal type and yellow background accents. Keep tips and head recesses mechanically consistent; no fake reactions, ratings or exaggerated claims. Variables: tool set and exact headline. ``` ## MKT-05 — Packing tutorial carousel cover ```text Create a 3:4 cover for a six-slide guide about packing fragile ceramics. Show a single bowl suspended visually between folded cardboard dividers, with a roll of paper cushioning at the bottom. Use an orderly overhead photograph on pale gray. Place "Pack with care" at the top, "A ceramic shipping guide" below, and "1/6" in the bottom-right corner. Keep the bowl intact and materials realistic. No shipping-company logos, guaranteed damage-prevention claims or additional words. Variables: object, title and slide count. ``` ## MKT-06 — Community workshop recruitment ```text Create a portrait 3:4 recruitment poster for a fictional bicycle-repair cooperative. Show an empty mechanic's apron hanging beside a neatly arranged tool board; leave the upper half clear for text. Use documentary photography, gentle window light and dark-green typography. Render "Join the workshop", "[ROLE]", "[CITY] · [SCHEDULE]", and "Apply by [DATE]" using supplied replacements. Keep tools recognizable and avoid invented salaries, certifications or contact details. Do not generate a QR code. Variables must all be replaced before generation. ``` ## MKT-07 — Reusable cup reminder ```text Create a 9:16 café notice encouraging customers to bring a reusable cup. Show one well-used cream travel cup beside a chalk-blue ceramic jug, photographed at counter height in warm morning light. Put "Your cup, your ritual" above and "Bring it next time" beneath the cup. Keep the middle spacious and lettering high contrast at viewing distance. No discount, environmental statistic or health claim; no additional objects or text. Preserve realistic lid geometry and grounded shadows. Variables: cup color and approved two-line message. ``` ## MKT-08 — Lantern walk identity frame ```text Create a 16:9 static key visual for a fictional evening lantern walk called "Paths of Light". A line of small amber paper lanterns curves through a dark botanical garden toward an open gate. Keep the center-left area quiet for the title; place "An evening together" immediately below. Use layered paper illustration with subtle depth and visible fiber texture, not neon effects. Avoid identifiable landmarks, sponsor logos and additional copy. This is one still concept frame, not an animated output. Variables: title, path shape and accent color. ``` ## MKT-09 — Repair workshop poster ```text Create a 3:4 poster for a fictional community repair workshop. Illustrate one terracotta table holding a yellow toaster, a small screwdriver and a spool of blue thread; two adult hands work on the toaster from opposite sides. Use clean cut-paper shapes, cream background, navy typography and generous spacing. At the top render "Repair Saturday"; beneath it render "Bring one small item"; at the bottom render "14:00–17:00". Render each line once and nothing else. Keep hands anatomically plausible and the toaster unplugged. Variables: approved localized text and palette. ``` ## MKT-10 — Service opening window notice ```text Create a 2:3 window notice for a fictional neighborhood photo-printing studio. Show three unbranded instant prints clipped to a single horizontal cord in the lower half. Above them render "Print your everyday", followed by "Opening [DATE]" and "[STREET]". Use tactile cream paper, cobalt type and natural shadows. Supply the date and address before generation; do not invent an opening offer. Keep all three prints distinct, image-only and free of private faces or readable personal documents. Variables: date, location and print subjects. ``` [Back to the prompt index](./README.md).
description_en: Ten Qwen Image 3.0 recipes for launch posters, podcast covers, thumbnails and campaign art, each fixing layout, lighting, exact rendered text and an explicit list of what not to draw.
description_zh: 十条面向 Qwen Image 3.0 的品牌营销出图配方，涵盖发布海报、播客封面、视频缩略图等，每条都锁定版式、光线、需精确渲染的文字，并明确列出不该出现的元素。
long_en: Each recipe is one paragraph of directing rather than tag soup: aspect ratio, subject placement ("the lamp occupies the lower two thirds"), a photographic or illustration style, the exact strings to render and their hierarchy, and a negative clause banning prices, certifications, sponsor logos or invented performance claims. Brands and events are deliberately fictional, and bracketed variables mark what you replace. The file opens by stating that outputs require human review.
long_zh: 每条配方都是一段导演式描述而非标签堆砌：画幅比例、主体位置（如「台灯占据画面下三分之二」）、摄影或插画风格、需要精确渲染的文字及其层级，以及一句否定约束——禁止出现价格、认证标识、赞助商 logo 或臆造的性能宣称。品牌与活动均为虚构，方括号变量标出需自行替换的部分。文件开头即声明：产出需人工复核。
sec_note_en: Plain text prompts; no tool access or external calls. Written and tuned for Qwen Image 3.0 — the structure transfers to other image models but exact text rendering will not. The repo is curated by the commercial image platform bestimage.ai and ships a page for its own API; these prompt files themselves carry no product placement and need no paid service to use.
sec_note_zh: 纯文本提示词，不涉及工具调用或外部请求。针对 Qwen Image 3.0 撰写与调优——这套结构可迁移到其它图像模型，但文字渲染的实际效果不会一致。来源仓库由商业图像平台 bestimage.ai 维护，并附有其自家 API 的介绍页；但这些提示词文件本身没有产品植入，使用时也不需要任何付费服务。
